newsitem.title: UK: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati said a new era had begun between Saudi Arabia and Iran.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sent bulldozers to a planned Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
- Saudi King Fahd urged the private sector to finance 45 percent of development projects.
- Lebanon and Germany are to sign an agreement to encourage investments.
- Qatar is in new talks with India about gas sales. Sources speak of a project to build a pipeline between the two states.
- An Italian economic team is in Lebanon.
- Trade between Egypt and Saudi Arabia increased to 2.5 billion Saudi riyals.
